### Key Risks to Know

- **Worsened side effects:** Both substances can cause dizziness, drowsiness, lightheadedness, and headaches, which can increase your risk of falls or accidents.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXxCjyBaUUGwEaJGp5MU2IDJQTLJSbFC_vU4KgXB4KnWWHenTNGkqUs4Mj3uN5RILNDQGYouYFWK0pSE5ehHC_-rjfM9BBfUKUo1-P2OxCGgomlBKYWnZklwxzfDIHSdk4eC9f55qBKNPAaaQxPwR8LF957vbYRg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-5Z2ZAlgX3uodExMwLJVVCKZTPslASqUg_aKhUzMLEIFarewYO_h_SDjEVkVMLK4tMZookmpW_um5tjh_iwoW6uVgnpaz7iUbrMrLx2iIA7SvJuLIkjftnUhSasfeY1gNWLHXIJuL5zxwaswwG_vEFwwhFC07iEFmR0VI3WeU3kNYF6XBHFM2pBZDmWp_NcSA)
- **Stomach irritation and dehydration:** Because Zofran is often prescribed for nausea or vomiting, drinking alcohol can irritate your stomach lining, worsen nausea, and increase dehydration. Most users on [Reddit](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1x4X-QUVFy1sULieM0g7zdVDWYlgm9NOtQDz-Rm6lKxmOY3XX_lE-4TolvFgf9ZLll1iw7bASZQGLE61b4NNCSSvCyhcSWzQ0fXoZqhgZk8BmI8Bk8a_oHZR0FkYH11-FF9o-ONJA1CsKwa6JyjzXRGEbNyVxNYqSm5Pd80) agree that avoiding alcohol is advisable when taking Zofran alongside medications like Zepbound because alcohol can irritate the stomach and counteract anti-nausea effects.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXF9UDIKHLZzH3MnwVLroUQ8maoV1LVjj3nSlqehkRKbEflusJ-1mwtj7krgOgJRFu8K03ZuFI-9_pVDpG0UXsAlFPhXCiy9qyVXR0CzOZ3p4ZJhbgxyum0_TF2OJvzMSrhNRY40d1TQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-5Z2ZAlgX3uodExMwLJVVCKZTPslASqUg_aKhUzMLEIFarewYO_h_SDjEVkVMLK4tMZookmpW_um5tjh_iwoW6uVgnpaz7iUbrMrLx2iIA7SvJuLIkjftnUhSasfeY1gNWLHXIJuL5zxwaswwG_vEFwwhFC07iEFmR0VI3WeU3kNYF6XBHFM2pBZDmWp_NcSA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESewHEIkXXxCjyBaUUGwEaJGp5MU2IDJQTLJSbFC_vU4KgXB4KnWWHenTNGkqUs4Mj3uN5RILNDQGYouYFWK0pSE5ehHC_-rjfM9BBfUKUo1-P2OxCGgomlBKYWnZklwxzfDIHSdk4eC9f55qBKNPAaaQxPwR8LF957vbYRg)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESgQEBxCJF1x4X-QUVFy1sULieM0g7zdVDWYlgm9NOtQDz-Rm6lKxmOY3XX_lE-4TolvFgf9ZLll1iw7bASZQGLE61b4NNCSSvCyhcSWzQ0fXoZqhgZk8BmI8Bk8a_oHZR0FkYH11-FF9o-ONJA1CsKwa6JyjzXRGEbNyVxNYqSm5Pd80)
- **Liver and heart strain:** Both alcohol and Zofran are processed by the liver, and combining them can add stress if you have liver issues. Rarely, combining factors that affect heart rhythm (such as QT-interval prolongation from Zofran or electrolyte shifts from heavy drinking) or serotonin activity can pose serious risks.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-5Z2ZAlgX3uodExMwLJVVCKZTPslASqUg_aKhUzMLEIFarewYO_h_SDjEVkVMLK4tMZookmpW_um5tjh_iwoW6uVgnpaz7iUbrMrLx2iIA7SvJuLIkjftnUhSasfeY1gNWLHXIJuL5zxwaswwG_vEFwwhFC07iEFmR0VI3WeU3kNYF6XBHFM2pBZDmWp_NcSA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXWj28rmQwBZXZlUQm3W1pDI_ueRvJGI7EFO_hujwG7N6CnjB1Iwwxnkq3T1s1FYEeIoDsf7ipZiq1r8ticKIGfTmh428ER7GjPjqLEw_IOutT_iAKoJAJrL4qz7vPk__3YjBTSrLZaExo)
- **Altered intoxication:** Clinical research on [PubMed](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXDYNjFKqMBb4PkV5F3-9X6vLeP9EV-eYPL9CJkek8TCLRN9gyBerY2qNRUB5_QYVhgOKT3in7L3C3ItBvLMV6yKnT2-ZKXHFiyhkmYnEvwdfTOwQyxsHwVS8ifbbD8g) shows ondansetron can alter subjective feelings of alcohol intoxication, and [JAMA Network](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXSWFxUM55s0u7RmyQqfNxVFg0CioaUy95cUB5kPbolh3ZzqtBw1N9ZTIJ4TXXH5MB2kGT7RNuB4Xmj0G3vjlMf-Xb_TFp4Td61poI8faCWIdU3n-IBCfb47IFxXVRCiqMG2LTnYNba3qbWEEWJZw) notes studies examining 5-HT3 blockade on alcohol's rewarding effects and urge to drink.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEScwHEIkXXSWFxUM55s0u7RmyQqfNxVFg0CioaUy95cUB5kPbolh3ZzqtBw1N9ZTIJ4TXXH5MB2kGT7RNuB4Xmj0G3vjlMf-Xb_TFp4Td61poI8faCWIdU3n-IBCfb47IFxXVRCiqMG2LTnYNba3qbWEEWJZw)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYwHEIkXXDYNjFKqMBb4PkV5F3-9X6vLeP9EV-eYPL9CJkek8TCLRN9gyBerY2qNRUB5_QYVhgOKT3in7L3C3ItBvLMV6yKnT2-ZKXHFiyhkmYnEvwdfTOwQyxsHwVS8ifbbD8g)

### Practical Precautions
If a healthcare provider says an occasional drink is acceptable for your situation, consider these steps:[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXWj28rmQwBZXZlUQm3W1pDI_ueRvJGI7EFO_hujwG7N6CnjB1Iwwxnkq3T1s1FYEeIoDsf7ipZiq1r8ticKIGfTmh428ER7GjPjqLEw_IOutT_iAKoJAJrL4qz7vPk__3YjBTSrLZaExo)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-5Z2ZAlgX3uodExMwLJVVCKZTPslASqUg_aKhUzMLEIFarewYO_h_SDjEVkVMLK4tMZookmpW_um5tjh_iwoW6uVgnpaz7iUbrMrLx2iIA7SvJuLIkjftnUhSasfeY1gNWLHXIJuL5zxwaswwG_vEFwwhFC07iEFmR0VI3WeU3kNYF6XBHFM2pBZDmWp_NcSA)

- **Check your health context:** Avoid alcohol completely if you have liver or heart conditions, are recovering from surgery or chemotherapy, or are taking other sedating medications.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXF9UDIKHLZzH3MnwVLroUQ8maoV1LVjj3nSlqehkRKbEflusJ-1mwtj7krgOgJRFu8K03ZuFI-9_pVDpG0UXsAlFPhXCiy9qyVXR0CzOZ3p4ZJhbgxyum0_TF2OJvzMSrhNRY40d1TQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-5Z2ZAlgX3uodExMwLJVVCKZTPslASqUg_aKhUzMLEIFarewYO_h_SDjEVkVMLK4tMZookmpW_um5tjh_iwoW6uVgnpaz7iUbrMrLx2iIA7SvJuLIkjftnUhSasfeY1gNWLHXIJuL5zxwaswwG_vEFwwhFC07iEFmR0VI3WeU3kNYF6XBHFM2pBZDmWp_NcSA)
- **Space out timing and keep amounts low:** Zofran has a half-life of about 4 hours, and limiting intake to at most one standard drink while drinking water helps reduce overlap and dehydration.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-5Z2ZAlgX3uodExMwLJVVCKZTPslASqUg_aKhUzMLEIFarewYO_h_SDjEVkVMLK4tMZookmpW_um5tjh_iwoW6uVgnpaz7iUbrMrLx2iIA7SvJuLIkjftnUhSasfeY1gNWLHXIJuL5zxwaswwG_vEFwwhFC07iEFmR0VI3WeU3kNYF6XBHFM2pBZDmWp_NcSA)
- **Watch for warning signs:** Stop drinking and seek medical care if you notice chest pain, irregular heartbeat, severe dizziness, confusion, or trouble breathing. For more guidance on precautions and dosing questions, see [SingleCare](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXWj28rmQwBZXZlUQm3W1pDI_ueRvJGI7EFO_hujwG7N6CnjB1Iwwxnkq3T1s1FYEeIoDsf7ipZiq1r8ticKIGfTmh428ER7GjPjqLEw_IOutT_iAKoJAJrL4qz7vPk__3YjBTSrLZaExo).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXWj28rmQwBZXZlUQm3W1pDI_ueRvJGI7EFO_hujwG7N6CnjB1Iwwxnkq3T1s1FYEeIoDsf7ipZiq1r8ticKIGfTmh428ER7GjPjqLEw_IOutT_iAKoJAJrL4qz7vPk__3YjBTSrLZaExo)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXX3USssAOkIeOs9bXBMcQo3KbrWPhkLUAwqQqrmdhnS0BQOv_o0y1vDSyQOWOkBWd2fCA4YL-Pj6ZJejqk5fS_Jgtf-trXtuvENQuix67ys_yKoHjglK5d-_xYDAsC94-L4jjJcA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXF9UDIKHLZzH3MnwVLroUQ8maoV1LVjj3nSlqehkRKbEflusJ-1mwtj7krgOgJRFu8K03ZuFI-9_pVDpG0UXsAlFPhXCiy9qyVXR0CzOZ3p4ZJhbgxyum0_TF2OJvzMSrhNRY40d1TQ)

- **Check your health context:** Avoid alcohol completely if you have liver or heart conditions, are recovering from surgery or chemotherapy, or are taking other sedating medications.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXF9UDIKHLZzH3MnwVLroUQ8maoV1LVjj3nSlqehkRKbEflusJ-1mwtj7krgOgJRFu8K03ZuFI-9_pVDpG0UXsAlFPhXCiy9qyVXR0CzOZ3p4ZJhbgxyum0_TF2OJvzMSrhNRY40d1TQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-5Z2ZAlgX3uodExMwLJVVCKZTPslASqUg_aKhUzMLEIFarewYO_h_SDjEVkVMLK4tMZookmpW_um5tjh_iwoW6uVgnpaz7iUbrMrLx2iIA7SvJuLIkjftnUhSasfeY1gNWLHXIJuL5zxwaswwG_vEFwwhFC07iEFmR0VI3WeU3kNYF6XBHFM2pBZDmWp_NcSA)
- **Space out timing and keep amounts low:** Zofran has a half-life of about 4 hours, and limiting intake to at most one standard drink while drinking water helps reduce overlap and dehydration.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlQEBxCJF1-5Z2ZAlgX3uodExMwLJVVCKZTPslASqUg_aKhUzMLEIFarewYO_h_SDjEVkVMLK4tMZookmpW_um5tjh_iwoW6uVgnpaz7iUbrMrLx2iIA7SvJuLIkjftnUhSasfeY1gNWLHXIJuL5zxwaswwG_vEFwwhFC07iEFmR0VI3WeU3kNYF6XBHFM2pBZDmWp_NcSA)
- **Watch for warning signs:** Stop drinking and seek medical care if you notice chest pain, irregular heartbeat, severe dizziness, confusion, or trouble breathing. For more guidance on precautions and dosing questions, see [SingleCare](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXWj28rmQwBZXZlUQm3W1pDI_ueRvJGI7EFO_hujwG7N6CnjB1Iwwxnkq3T1s1FYEeIoDsf7ipZiq1r8ticKIGfTmh428ER7GjPjqLEw_IOutT_iAKoJAJrL4qz7vPk__3YjBTSrLZaExo).[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbgHEIkXXWj28rmQwBZXZlUQm3W1pDI_ueRvJGI7EFO_hujwG7N6CnjB1Iwwxnkq3T1s1FYEeIoDsf7ipZiq1r8ticKIGfTmh428ER7GjPjqLEw_IOutT_iAKoJAJrL4qz7vPk__3YjBTSrLZaExo)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESaQHEIkXX3USssAOkIeOs9bXBMcQo3KbrWPhkLUAwqQqrmdhnS0BQOv_o0y1vDSyQOWOkBWd2fCA4YL-Pj6ZJejqk5fS_Jgtf-trXtuvENQuix67ys_yKoHjglK5d-_xYDAsC94-L4jjJcA)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXF9UDIKHLZzH3MnwVLroUQ8maoV1LVjj3nSlqehkRKbEflusJ-1mwtj7krgOgJRFu8K03ZuFI-9_pVDpG0UXsAlFPhXCiy9qyVXR0CzOZ3p4ZJhbgxyum0_TF2OJvzMSrhNRY40d1TQ)
